about: Phrasings of the My Patient text with the reading each should get. Kept from the rules reader's corpus (tests/test_patient_text_corpus.py, removed when the model became the reader): 'refused' marks a text the rules could not settle; for the model it is a judgement to review, not a failure. scripts/eval_patient_extraction.py reads every text live and reports agreement.
